newsitem.title: CHINA: China eases cargo passage between Shenzhen, HK.
newsitem.headline: China eases cargo passage between Shenzhen, HK.

text.p: China has simplified procedures for trucks passing between Hong Kong and the southern city of Shenzhen to try to speed up cargo shipments between the two cities, the Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.
Under the changes, effective from Tuesday, many inspection duties formerly divided between customs and immigration departments would be unified under customs offices, Xinhua said.

The changes would affect passage at Huanggang, Shatoujiao and Wenjindu checkpoints on Shenzhen's border with Hong Kong, which became a special administrative region of China on July 1, the agency said.
"Passing procedures at three checkpoints...became simpler as of today in a move to increase the speed of vehicles and cargo across these sites," it said.
Trucks passing through those points would only have to be inspected by customs and no longer by immigration departments, it said.
Trucks were previously inspected by both departments, it said but gave no further details.
